notes.title: July 12, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1522
notes.notes: [p]Added furniture:​​ Sorting Table. You can now sort parts on the sorting table to craft higher-tier items.[/p][p]​Added furniture:​​ Sticky Notes. You can now use sticky notes in hideouts to label various furniture for easier categorization.[/p][p]Added functionality to interact with curtains in random scenes. You can now tear down curtains in scenes to obtain more cloth and brighter environments.[/p][p]Added inventory sorting functionality.[/p][p]Added tips to loading screens.[/p][p]Adjusted save logic to improve save performance.[/p][p]Improved animation for most character actions.[/p][p][/p][p]​Fixed issues where:​​[/p][p]Dismantling cabinets would cause errors;[/p][p]Food consumption could trigger incorrect calorie calculations under specific circumstances;[/p][p]Crosshairs would fail to highlight objects in certain situations;[/p][p]Various problems in random scenes;[/p][p]Several issues with workbenches;[/p][p]Lockpicking volume fluctuating unexpectedly;[/p][p]Holding multiple items during interactions under specific conditions.[/p][p]​[/p][p]Visual improvements:​​[/p][p]Enhanced animations for some menu buttons[/p][p]Improved world map interface[/p][p]Refined certain fonts[/p]

notes.title: June 2, 2025 Changelog - Alpha 1427
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Remade the Hideout scene to fix severe frame rate drops.​​
[*]  We apologize that we had to remake this scene to fully fix the previous bug. This means old save files may become incompatible (items originally placed in the scene might be misplaced or disappear). We will pay closer attention to save file compatibility in the future to reduce the chances of saves becoming completely or partially unusable.
[*] Optimized ray tracing settings.​​
[*] Added sound effects during movement.​​
[*] Fixed minor issues in random scenes.​​
[*] Fixed some minor localization issues.​​
[/list]
